ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation zone extending from the peduncle toward the notch and along the inner trailing edges. Left lobe contains a cluster of small, circular dark spots near the distal tip. Right lobe features three prominent, isolated dark circular spots in the upper-mid region on a predominantly white background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped notch with an approximate pixel-derived angle of 130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge of both lobes; more pronounced jaggedness observed on the inner edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly sigmoidal curve leading to tapered, upward-turning distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark spots on both lobes; textured, high-relief clusters at the fluke tips indicating biological colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, characterized by yellowish-white, high-relief clusters.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray and turbulence occlude the central peduncle-to-fluke junction, obscuring potential markers in the lower-central region.
